metas.name: Murder in a Small Town
metas.description: Karl Alberg moves to a quiet coastal town to soothe a psyche that has been battered by big-city police work, but finds himself needing to call upon all his skills to solve the murders that continue to wash up on his shore.

metas.name: Fargo
metas.description: Various chronicles of deception, intrigue, and murder in and around frozen Minnesota. All of these tales mysteriously lead back one way or another to Fargo, North Dakota.

metas.name: The X-Files
metas.description: FBI Special Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully investigate unsolved unexplained cases known as X-Files.

metas.name: Rick and Morty
metas.description: The fractured domestic lives of a nihilistic mad scientist and his anxious grandson are further complicated by their inter-dimensional misadventures.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: Blue Lights
metas.description: Follows rookie police officers working in Belfast, a city in which being a frontline response cop comes with unique pressures and dangers.

metas.name: The Americans
metas.description: At the height of the Cold War, married KGB spies pose as Americans in Washington, D.C.

metas.name: Lost
metas.description: The survivors of a plane crash are forced to work together in order to survive on a seemingly deserted tropical island.

metas.name: It: Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

metas.name: The Big Bang Theory
metas.description: The lives of four socially awkward scientists take a wild turn when a beautiful and free-spirited girl moves in next door.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: Three different, but related, families face trials and tribulations in their own uniquely comedic ways.

metas.name: Mad Men
metas.description: A drama about one of New York's most prestigious ad agencies at the beginning of the 1960s, focusing on one of the firm's most mysterious but extremely talented ad executives, Donald Draper.

metas.name: Shameless
metas.description: A scrappy, feisty, fiercely loyal Chicago family makes no apologies.

metas.name: House
metas.description: Using a crack team of doctors and his wits, an antisocial maverick doctor specializing in diagnostic medicine does whatever it takes to solve puzzling cases that come his way.

metas.name: The Last of Us
metas.description: After a global pandemic destroys civilization, a hardened survivor takes charge of a 14-year-old girl who may be humanity's last hope.

metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: SEAL Team
metas.description: The lives of the elite Navy SEALs as they train, plan, and execute the most dangerous, high-stakes missions the United States of America can ask.

metas.name: ER
metas.description: The doctors who work in the ER at the County General Hospital in Chicago grapple with ups and downs in their personal and professional lives while trying to give apt medical care to their patients.

metas.name: Paradise
metas.description: A Secret Service agent investigates the murder of a former president in a seemingly peaceful community.

metas.name: Untitled Snowfall Spinoff
metas.description: As 1990s LA shifts from crack to rap, gang territories controlled by Bloods and Crips become ground zero for an emerging music scene in South Central.

metas.name: Chernobyl
metas.description: In April 1986, the city of Chernobyl in the Soviet Union suffers one of the worst nuclear disasters in the history of mankind. Consequently, many heroes put their lives on the line in the following days, weeks and months.

metas.name: Agatha All Along
metas.description: A spell-bound Agatha Harkness regains freedom thanks to a teen's help. Intrigued by his plea, she embarks on the Witches' Road trials to reclaim her powers and discover the teen's motivations.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders
metas.description: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England; centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby.

metas.name: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
metas.description: This prequel to the Outlander series focuses on the lives and courtship of the parents of Jamie Fraser: Brian Fraser and Ellen Mackenzie as well as Claire Beauchamp's parents, Henry Beauchamp and Julia Moriston.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: A grieving therapist starts to tell his clients exactly what he thinks. Ignoring his training and ethics, he finds himself making huge changes to people's lives - including his own.

metas.name: Kill Jackie
metas.description: Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.

metas.name: The Blacklist
metas.description: A new FBI profiler, Elizabeth Keen, has her entire life uprooted when a mysterious criminal, Raymond Reddington, who has eluded capture for decades, turns himself in and insists on speaking only to her.

metas.name: Euphoria
metas.description: A dark coming-of-age drama exploring love, addiction, friendship and identity in a world full of temptation and uncertainty.

metas.name: Matlock
metas.description: Follows Madeline Matlock as she rejoins the work force at a prestigious law firm, where she uses her wily tactics to win cases and expose wrongdoing.

metas.name: The Simpsons
metas.description: The satiric half-hour adventures of a working-class family in the misfit city of Springfield.

metas.name: Boston Blue
metas.description: Danny Reagan joins Boston PD from NYPD and partners with Detective Lena Silver, the oldest daughter of a notable Boston law enforcement family.

metas.name: Suits
metas.description: On the run from a drug deal gone bad, brilliant college dropout Mike Ross finds himself working with Harvey Specter, one of New York City's best lawyers.

metas.name: Coven Academy
metas.description: Teen witch apprentices band together to defend New Orleans against an approaching dark force.

metas.name: Girls
metas.description: A comedy about the experiences of a group of girls in their early 20s.

metas.name: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
metas.description: A prequel to Star Trek (1966), this series follows the crew of the USS Enterprise under the command of Captain Christopher Pike.

metas.name: Bones
metas.description: F.B.I. Special Agent Seeley Booth teams up with the Jeffersonian's top anthropologist, Dr. Temperance Brennan, to investigate cases where all that's left of the victims are their bones.

metas.name: Fire Country
metas.description: A young convict joins a firefighting program looking for redemption and a shortened prison sentence. He and other inmates work alongside elite firefighters to extinguish massive blazes across the region.

metas.name: Chicago P.D.
metas.description: Follows the lives of the personnel of the fictional 21st District, which houses both uniformed officers and the department's elite Intelligence Unit as they fight every day to keep the city of Chicago, Illinois safe.

metas.name: I Will Find You
metas.description: A father imprisoned for his son's murder receives evidence suggesting his child may be alive, compelling him to escape and uncover the truth.

metas.name: FBI
metas.description: Follows the inner workings of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (also known as the FBI for short) as they fight to keep New York City and the country safe.

metas.name: Loki
metas.description: The mercurial villain Loki resumes his role as the God of Mischief in a new series that takes place after the events of “Avengers: Endgame.”

metas.name: Outlander
metas.description: Honeymooning in 1945 Scotland, a combat nurse is suddenly transported back to the 1700s.

metas.name: Smallville
metas.description: The origins of the world’s greatest hero–from Krypton refugee Kal-el’s arrival on Earth through his tumultuous teen years to Clark Kent’s final steps toward embracing his destiny as the Man of Steel.

metas.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
metas.description: After swallowing a cursed relic, kindhearted teenager Yuji Itadori becomes host to the King of Curses and joins a secret school of sorcerers battling monsters born from humanity's darkest emotions.

metas.name: Twin Peaks
metas.description: An idiosyncratic FBI agent investigates the murder of a young woman in the even more idiosyncratic town of Twin Peaks.

metas.name: The Vampire Diaries
metas.description: The lives, loves, dangers and disasters in the town, Mystic Falls, Virginia. Creatures of unspeakable horror lurk beneath this town as a teenage girl is suddenly torn between two vampire brothers.

metas.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
metas.description: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.

metas.name: The Gilded Age
metas.description: The conflicts surrounding the new money Russell family and their old money neighbors, the van Rhijn family, in 1880s New York City high society.

metas.name: Fallout
metas.description: In a future, post-apocalyptic Los Angeles brought about by nuclear decimation, citizens must live in underground bunkers to protect themselves from radiation, mutants and bandits.

metas.name: Seeking Persephone
metas.description: Impoverished Persephone marries reclusive Duke, hoping his wealth rescues her family. She persists in connecting with the man beneath his scarred psyche and imposing estate. Grave peril forces him to risk vulnerability to protect ...

metas.name: Glee
metas.description: A group of ambitious misfits try to escape the harsh realities of high school by joining a glee club headed by a passionate Spanish teacher.

metas.name: Chicago Fire
metas.description: Follows both the professional and personal lives of the firefighters, rescue personnel, and paramedics of the Chicago Fire Department at the fictional Firehouse 51 as they risk their lives to save and protect the city of Chicago, ...

metas.name: Andor
metas.description: In an era filled with danger, deception, and intrigue, Cassian Andor embarks on a path that is destined to turn him into a Rebel hero.

metas.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
metas.description: After a century frozen in ice, young Avatar Aang journeys with friends to master the four elements and bring balance to a world at war with the Fire Nation.

metas.name: Vikings
metas.description: Vikings transports us to the brutal and mysterious world of Ragnar Lothbrok, a Viking warrior and farmer who yearns to explore--and raid--the distant shores across the ocean.

metas.name: The Fall of the House of Usher
metas.description: The children of Roderick Usher, a CEO of a corrupt pharmaceutical company, begin to die in mysterious, brutal ways.

metas.name: How I Met Your Mother
metas.description: A father recounts to his children the journey he and his four best friends took leading up to him meeting their mother.

metas.name: Heated Rivalry
metas.description: Two rival hockey stars at the top of their game face an unexpected challenge when they develop feelings for each other, complicating their careers and the sport's expectations.

metas.name: NCIS: New York
metas.description: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his NYC hometown field office, teaming with a roguish agent to lead a new team on high-stakes missions defending one of the world's most vital cities and ports.

metas.name: Dutton Ranch
metas.description: Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler fight to survive on their cherished 7,000-acre ranch amid tough times and stiff competition, while ensuring young Carter becomes the man he's supposed to be.

metas.name: CIA
metas.description: Follows a partnership between an FBI agent and a CIA Case Officer who work together on a clandestine taskforce to prevent domestic terrorism in New York.

metas.name: Doc
metas.description: Dr. Amy Larsen loses her memory during a car accident. She must return to being an intern and somehow rebuild her life from the pieces that remain.

metas.name: The Handmaid's Tale
metas.description: Set in a dystopian future, a woman is forced to live as a concubine under a fundamentalist theocratic dictatorship.

metas.name: NCIS: Origins
metas.description: Follows a young Leroy Jethro Gibbs as he starts his career as part of the Naval Investigative Service operating out of Camp Pendleton.

metas.name: The West Wing
metas.description: Follows US president Josiah Bartlet and his administration as they tackle various political issues in order to maintain peace and harmony in the nation.

metas.name: Hollywood Arts
metas.description: Trina Vega comes back to teach at Hollywood's premier performing arts school, where she was once a student.

metas.name: The Blame
metas.description: Two detectives fall in love while investigating a murder, until one becomes a suspect.

metas.name: Banshee
metas.description: An ex-con assumes the identity of a murdered sheriff in the small town of Banshee, Pennsylvania, where he has some unfinished business.

metas.name: The Punisher
metas.description: After his revenge on those who murdered his family, aimless Marine veteran Frank Castle finds a new meaning in life as a vigilante known as "The Punisher".

metas.name: WandaVision
metas.description: Blends the style of classic sitcoms with the MCU, in which Wanda Maximoff and Vision - two super-powered beings living their ideal suburban lives - begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

metas.name: The Witcher
metas.description: Geralt of Rivia, a solitary monster hunter, struggles to find his place in a world where people often prove more wicked than beasts.

metas.name: Sons of Anarchy
metas.description: A biker struggles to balance being a father and being involved in an outlaw motorcycle club.

metas.name: Over the Garden Wall
metas.description: Two brothers find themselves lost in a mysterious land and try to find their way home.

metas.name: Family Guy
metas.description: In a wacky Rhode Island town, a dysfunctional family strives to cope with everyday life as they are thrown from one crazy scenario to another.

metas.name: The Beast in Me
metas.description: Author Aggie Wiggs, grieving the loss of her son, finds new purpose unraveling the mystery behind neighbor Nile Jarvis' vanished wife and his suspicious dealings.

metas.name: Homeland
metas.description: A bipolar CIA Case Officer conducts covert operations to protect her nation from terrorist acts.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A group of actors move to Los Angeles to make it big, but end up working as caterers.

metas.name: Doctor Who
metas.description: Continuing on from Doctor Who (1963), this revival follows the further adventures of the Doctor and their companions as they encounter various alien threats and save civilizations on different planets and time periods.

metas.name: Young Sheldon
metas.description: Meet a child genius named Sheldon Cooper (already seen as an adult in The Big Bang Theory (2007)) and his family. Some unique challenges face Sheldon, who is socially impaired.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: The absurd antics of an Indiana town's public officials as they pursue sundry projects to make their city a better place.

metas.name: The Curse
metas.description: A newlywed couple struggle to make their vision for eco-living a reality in a small New Mexico town.

metas.name: Mr. Robot
metas.description: Elliot, a brilliant but unstable cyber-security engineer and vigilante hacker, becomes a key figure in a complex game of global chaos when he and his shadowy allies try to take down the corrupt corporation his company is paid to p...

metas.name: The Day of the Jackal
metas.description: The Jackal is an elusive assassin who makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. He soon meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who tracks him down in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe.

metas.name: Invincible
metas.description: When 17-year-old Mark Grayson inherits superpowers, he becomes the superhero Invincible.

metas.name: Sterling Point
metas.description: Annie and her twin brother, raised in NYC by their single father, discover their estranged grandfather bequeathed them a lake island.

metas.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
metas.description: Demigod Percy Jackson leads a quest across America to prevent a war among the Olympian gods.

metas.name: True Blood
metas.description: Thanks to a Japanese scientist's invention of synthetic blood, vampires have progressed overnight from legendary monsters to fellow citizens. And while humans have been safely removed from the menu, many remain apprehensive about these creatures "coming out of the coffin." Religious leaders, government officials, and vampire fundamentalists around the world have chosen their sides.  But in the small Louisiana town of Bon Temps, the jury is still out.

metas.name: One Tree Hill
metas.description: Half-brothers Lucas and Nathan Scott trade between kinship and rivalry both on the basketball court and in the hearts of their friends in the small, but not so quiet town of Tree Hill, North Carolina.

metas.name: Castle
metas.description: Successful author Richard Castle teams up with NYPD Detective Kate Beckett to solve complex murder cases.

metas.name: Helluva Boss
metas.description: This adult animated comedy follows the misadventures, hijinks, and relationships of the Immediate Murder Professionals (or I.M.P. for short)-- a band of demon assassins from Hell who kill people on Earth for a living.

metas.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
metas.description: A young woman, destined to slay vampires, demons and other infernal creatures, deals with her life fighting evil, with the help of her friends.

metas.name: The Leftovers
metas.description: Three years after the disappearance of 2% of the global human population, a group of people in a small New York community try to continue their lives while coping with the tragedy of the unexplained nature of the event.

metas.name: High Potential
metas.description: Morgan is a single mom with an exceptional mind, whose unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

metas.name: Prison Break
metas.description: A structural engineer installs himself in a prison his company helped design, to save his falsely accused brother from a death sentence by breaking both of them out from the inside.

metas.name: Community
metas.description: A suspended lawyer is forced to enroll in a community college with an eccentric staff and student body.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Comedy series following the exploits of Det. Jake Peralta and his diverse, lovable colleagues as they police the NYPD's 99th Precinct.

metas.name: Heroes
metas.description: Ordinary people discover that they possess extraordinary powers.

metas.name: Ozark
metas.description: A financial advisor drags his family from Chicago to the Missouri Ozarks, where he must launder money to appease a drug boss.

metas.name: Arcane
metas.description: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

metas.name: For All Mankind
metas.description: In an alternative version of 1969, the Soviet Union beats the United States to the Moon, and the space race continues on for decades with still grander challenges and goals.
